panel.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Production game UI background SPRITE only for a pet equipment purchase dialog. Reference is the existing game's fantasy wooden inventory UI; match its friendly classic MapleStory hand-painted 2D material/contour quality, but design a NEW purpose-built elegant purchase dialog.
Deliver ONE front-on rectangular panel, aspect ratio exactly 1000:720, centered on a genuinely transparent canvas with transparent safety gutters. No perspective. Main body pale warm ivory parchment for dark readable live text, framed with a restrained medium-brown wooden border with a thin warm gold inner rim, crisp contour and soft bevel, clean Korean fantasy RPG UI. Sparse tiny leaves only at top-left OUTER corner, nothing at bottom corners. No gems, no mushrooms, no big ornaments. The outer frame must be a complete clean rectangle with gently rounded corners. No ground shadow or background haze.
Use a logical 1000 wide x720 high coordinate system (origin top left of the actual panel):
- An EMPTY dark warm wood title plaque centered x500,y105, size640x76, entirely INSIDE panel and far below top border. Leave it blank; title will be real text drawn by game.
- Main pale parchment area x50..950, y170..534.
- Left EMPTY rounded ivory inset display well centered x240,y302, size200x200, thin gold-beige edge, flat center; no item inside.
- Small EMPTY light sage-cream bonus card centered x240,y473, size300x90 with delicate thin trim; no text.
- Very subtle vertical divider at x430 from y185 to y515. Right x470..920 remains flat clean parchment, no boxes/lines/placeholders in this right area.
- Bottom INNER footer x50..950 y548..680 is completely empty calm pale parchment with a faint horizontal separator at y548. Reserve it for two game buttons, centered y620; DO NOT draw any buttons, button slots, labels or icons here. Both future buttons must fit entirely within this footer with large interior margins.
Panel must have spacious padding and consistent thickness. No decorative object may intrude into title, display well, right content, or footer.
ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, NUMERALS, ICONS, currency, item, labels, wireframe marks or fake letters anywhere. This is a clean blank skin for live UI, not a screenshot. True alpha transparency outside the single complete panel.

buttons.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: game UI button sprite atlas on true transparent background. Match the classic MapleStory-like hand-painted wood and fine gold RPG UI styling of the supplied inventory reference, but design clean dedicated purchase-dialog buttons with restrained borders. NO text/icons.
EXACTLY SIX separate matching-size horizontal rounded rectangle buttons in strict THREE columns x TWO rows grid, large clear transparent gutters. Each button aspect280:76, occupies about82% of cell width; all buttons same outline/dimensions. Thin dark warm brown contour, fine gold rim, rounded corners, subtle 2D bevel; no leaves/gems/mushrooms or protruding decorations. Smooth clean fills, clear edges. No background or drop-shadow haze.
Reading order:
top-left vivid forest green normal purchase button, top-middle same green brighter hover button, top-right muted desaturated olive-grey disabled purchase button.
bottom-left warm ivory-beige normal cancel button with brown edge, bottom-middle same ivory brighter hover, bottom-right slightly darker beige pressed cancel button.
The middle interiors are BLANK uniform clean color so live text is legible. Do not paint any Korean/English word, numbers or symbols. Align all shapes and use consistent pixel scale, ample fully transparent gaps around each sprite and all canvas edges. True alpha transparency.
